en.title: Abide with Me
en.author: Henry F. Lyte
stanzas:
I need Thy presence every passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's pow'r?
Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Lord, abide with me.

notes: The five-stanza hymnal form — Timeless Truths and hymnary's representative text both print five. Lyte's 1847 poem has eight stanzas; the three beginning "Not a brief glance", "Thou on my head", and "Come not in terrors" are rarely sung and are not shipped. Tune EVENTIDE (William H. Monk, 1861); meter as hymnary lists it. Key: the hymnal key is E-flat (Timeless Truths score); D and E are each one semitone away and FORMAT's preference order picks D. Chords follow Monk's harmonization simplified for guitar, keeping his line-3 sequence (V7-of-vi into Bm, then V7-of-V into the half cadence).
